Summary
: The English translation of the Isopanisad including the commentary of Madhva called the Bhasya. This Isha Upanishad is an important text associated with the Shukla Yajurveda and teaches about topics such as Atman, Karma, Vidya, Advidya and other concepts important to both Dvaita and Advaita Vedanta school of Hindu philsophy.
This edition the original Sanskrit text, word-for-word translation, English text, and the commentary of Madhvacharya.
The Isopanisad is also known as: Īśopaniṣad (ईशोपनिषद्, ishopanishad), Īśāvāsyopaniṣad (ईशावास्योपनिषद्, isavasyopanisad, ishavasyopanishad), Īśa-upaniṣad (ईश-उपनिषद्, isa-upanisad, isha-upanishad) or Īśāvāsya-upaniṣad (ईशावास्य-उपनिषद्, isavasya-upanisad, ishavasya-upanishad).
